name: Bundle-based adjustment / inclusive-price bundle
expected: Inclusive-price bundle: parent bundle line receives Bundle_Based_Adjustment (BundleBasedAdjustmentEntries BKM, parentStep ListContainer25) keyed on MainItemProduct/RootItemProduct+InclusivePrice -> discounted bundle net flows to TotalLineAmount; each inclusive-price child (DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild=true, InclusivePrice=true) has its TotalLineAmount set to InclusivePriceConstant (=0) via Assignment98 (parentStep ListContainer96, filtered by ListOperation97 InclusivePrice Equals true) so child revenue rolls into the parent. test_setup oracle (a-la-carte 17.064k, 15% off) is stale vs current catalog.
actual: MECHANISM CONFIRMED WORKING on real UI-priced records, but the fresh headless smoke-test is a harness artifact -> BLOCKED. (1) Positive controls (Activated orders, V21-priced via UI convert): GoAnywhere Starter Bundle (GOA-GAM-NRPS-GASBP) parent ListPrice=35679 -> NetUnitPrice/TotalLineAmount=6330.99 (order 801WC00000hKJCiYAO line 802WC00000N2XJJYA3, ~82.3% bundle discount) and 6013.19 (801WC00000hKUg9YAG); inclusive children (Advanced Workflows list 26450, SFTP/FTPS 4025, Secure Folders 7475, FTP Client 0) -> TotalLineAmount=0; over-bundle a-la-carte extras priced normally. 'with Gateway' variant (GOA-GAM-NRPS-GASBGP) list 42521 -> 8504.40 on order 801WC00000hHaXyYAK. The InclusivePrice/bundle-adjustment branch is live and correct on real records. (2) Fresh smoke-test: Force-reprice (REST place isSuccess=true, errorResponse:[]) of UI-built bundle quote 0Q0WC000002RK6g0AG (Optum, 3 bundle parents + full inclusive children) -> bundle parents went 35679 list -> NetUnitPrice/TotalLineAmount=35679 (bundle discount LOST, back to full list) and several inclusive children (Advanced Workflows) jumped 0 -> 26450 (a-la-carte list, inclusive suppression LOST) while others (Secure Folders/SFTP/FTPS) stayed 0 -> inconsistent partial result. Cause: InclusivePrice is sourced from context node SalesTransaction/SalesTransactionItem/SalesTrxnItemRelationship/IsPriceInclusive/InclusivePrice, i.e. the transient bundle parent-child RELATIONSHIP node; ParentQuoteLineItemId/ParentOrderItemId are null on saved lines and the headless place action with configurationMethod:Skip does NOT rebuild SalesTrxnItemRelationship -> InclusivePrice resolves false/null, ListOperation97 filters nothing, BundleBasedAdjustmentEntries finds no MainItem/RootItem key, so the branch never runs on the intended inputs.

defectStep: N/A (intended branch did not run on valid inputs in the headless harness; on real UI-priced records the branch -- BundleBasedAdjustmentEntries / ListOperation97 InclusivePrice=true / Assignment98 -- runs correctly)
proposedFix: Validation gap only: bundle/inclusive-price scenarios cannot be smoke-tested via the headless place API (configurationMethod:Skip) because it does not reconstruct the SalesTrxnItemRelationship/IsPriceInclusive context node that gates InclusivePrice. To re-validate D-08, drive it through the UI 'Add Products' bundle configurator (or Quote->Order convert) so the configurator builds the bundle membership, then reprice. NO procedure/config change indicated -- the active V21 bundle branch is correctly wired and demonstrably prices real records. Separately, correct the stale catalog oracle: current GoAnywhere Starter Bundle list=35679 USD, child a-la-carte sum=43975 USD, observed bundle discount ~82% (NOT 17.064k / 15%). NOT APPLIED (validation only).
notes: Branch trace (active V21): ListContainer25 (filter ItemPricingSource != LastTransaction) -> BundleBasedAdjustmentEntries BKM looks up Bundle_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table via MainItemProduct/RootItemProduct + InclusivePrice, writes NetUnitPrice + Subtotal(ItemNetTotalPrice). Separately ListContainer96 -> ListOperation97 (InclusivePrice Equals true) -> Assignment98 sets TotalLineAmount = InclusivePriceConstant (Constant=0), zeroing inclusive-child revenue (rolled to parent). CalculationMatrix 'Bundle Based Adjustment Entries' 0lIa5000000MYcXEAW has 0 versions/0 rows and org-wide CalculationMatrixRow count=0, so the bundle adjustment data is not held in CalculationMatrixRow -- the native BundleDiscount action resolves discounts/inclusion from the bundle structure (ProductRelatedComponent.DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild=true on all 6 GoAnywhere Starter Bundle children) at configure time, surfaced through SalesTrxnItemRelationship; this is why a config-Skip reprice cannot reproduce it. SC-3346 Tripwire/FIM 'wrong bundle format' (those bundle SKUs lack the Maintenance Type attribute / have $0 list) is a separate Fortra-owned catalog cleanup, not a V21 defect (per project_derived_pricing_demo_recipe 2026-06-29). Anti-phantom-defect: only failing evidence is a fresh headless reprice -> BLOCKED, not FAIL; real records prove the mechanism. SIDE EFFECT: the Force-reprice left Won quote 0Q0WC000002RK6g0AG parents at list 35679 and Advanced Workflows children at 26450 (was 0); no procedure/metadata changed; can be UI-repriced to restore. verdict_reason captured below.
verdict_reason: Active V21 bundle branch (BundleBasedAdjustmentEntries + ListOperation97 InclusivePrice=true + Assignment98) is correctly wired and demonstrably prices REAL UI/convert records (list 35679 -> TotalLineAmount ~6000-6500, inclusive children $0), but the scenario cannot be smoke-tested on a fresh/repriced line because the headless place API (config Skip) does not rebuild the SalesTrxnItemRelationship/IsPriceInclusive context that gates InclusivePrice -> the failing reprice is a harness artifact, so BLOCKED (TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT), not a defect.
